name: send-co
description: Publish pages and documents as live links. See when they're opened and control who can open them.

interface.shortDescription: Share work as a tracked link
interface.longDescription: Turn what you're making into a live page with one link: a proposal, a report, a one-pager, a dashboard. Edit it in place and the link stays the same. See when it's opened, ask visitors for their name or email first, add a passcode or an expiry date, and host it on your own domain.
capabilities: Publish a page or document as a shareable link
Edit a page you published, keeping its link
Ask visitors for their name or email before they view
Add a passcode or an expiry date to a page
Find the link to a page you published
defaultPrompt: Publish this as a Send page I can share
Make a one-page proposal on Send
Require an email to open my last Send page

positive.description: Publish a one-page summary as a link
positive.prompt: Make a one-page Send site summarizing our Q3 launch plan: March 15 launch, three regions, budget $40k. Give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: CreateSite is called first with intent only, then with the HTML. The reply gives a send.co share link, and the page shows inline.

positive.description: Edit a page made earlier in the conversation
positive.prompt: On that Send page, change the budget to $45k and make the heading say Q3 Launch.
positive.expected_behavior: The page at the same share link now shows $45k and the new heading. No new link is created.

positive.description: Ask visitors for their email before they view
positive.prompt: Make visitors enter their email before they can open my Send page.
positive.expected_behavior: manage_sites reads the documentation for the site, then turns on the email requirement. The reply says visitors now see an email form first and the owner does not.

positive.prompt: Add a passcode to my most recent Send page.
positive.expected_behavior: manage_sites lists recent sites and updates the newest one. On a plan without passcodes, the reply says the feature is not included in the plan and links send.co/pricing; nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: What's the link to the Send page I made earlier?
positive.expected_behavior: The reply gives the share link of the most recent site.

negative.description: General question unrelated to publishing pages. Send should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto today?

negative.description: Coding request with no publishing. Send should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.

negative.description: Another service's data. Send has no access to email, so it should not be called.

review.commerce_description: Send does not sell products or process payments in this plugin. When a feature is not in the user's plan, Send says so and links the informational page send.co/pricing.
